title: No EU appetite for Russian gas so far, as US and European negotiators discuss Ukraine peace deal
lede: "The EU is sticking to abandoning fossil-fuel dependency on Russia," said one diplomat, as US, EU, and Ukrainian negotiators meet in Brussels, following reports of US pressure to resume Russian gas imports as part of a peace deal.
